author: BootlegGiant

subject: Hail to the king!
author: Xandu
body:
Duke’s weapons are far superior to Master Chief’s. One shot with his Shrinking gun and the 7 foot Master Chief would only be 8”. Then just step on him and he would be a splat on the floor. Duke also has some really cool items that he can use including steroids, holo-duke and the jetpack. Duke also has a armor but he normally doesn’t need it as he is not a little cry boy like Master Chief! 
HAIL TO THE KING BABY! 😃

-- The Creator --

body:
The Master Chief is around 7 feet tall He has half a ton of armour on, He is a master of all weapons and apparently he can do a few magic tricks with the BR, (not that I would know these), Duke vs MC = Duke crying like a baby

subject: re: Everything you never knew about Halo
author: Xandu
body:
What if Duke Nukem Forever had been done 5 years ago or maybe even 10 years ago? I think world would have been totally different. I really hope that 3DRealms will come back to rule the world. Duke is kind of fading away for me now and the only good lines I still remember are the following; "HAIL TO THE KING BABY!", "Don't have time to play with myself", "Shake it baby!". There is no doubt that Duke would KICK Master Chiefs A$$! 😃

-- The Creator --

subject: For those interested in the possible Halo movie
author: SUFFUR
body:
Here are some links to some footage and Weta workshop who are working on the project, i need to get  networking, i should have been working as a camera man on this stuff, i can take a spiker hit?lol!

The third short http://dsc.discovery.com/tv/last-one-standing/halo-sweeps/halo-sweeps.html shows some good stuff and you need to enter your age. But it has the Brutes, needler shot and rocket launcher, as well as the flying machines like , Ghosts and Banshies as well as in the second short a Pelican and Warthog drop.

The Weta workshop page with the other 2 shorts, some of you may have seen them before but for those who have not,

http://www.wetaworkshop.co.nz/projects/filmography/film/halo3 has links to all three shorts.

This stuff all looks great, and makes the film Black Hawk Down look like a school football fight(yes i know its based on real events[BHD], but movies are for the imagination to expand and Halo is from the imagination) lets just hope the story is good, no, great?! Though i'm happy to see movie battles till the cows come home.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
